# Fetchling

> A TanStack Query-inspired async data fetching and state management library for .NET and Blazor: automatic caching, background refetching, stale-while-revalidate, reactive state and mutations, built on Rx.NET.

Packages: `Fetchling` (metapackage: Core + DI), `Fetchling.Core` (always required), `Fetchling.Extensions.DependencyInjection` (`AddFetchling()`), `Fetchling.Blazor` (`<Suspense>`, `<Transition>`), `Fetchling.Blazor.DevTools` (`<QueryDevTools>`, development only) and `Fetchling.Mvvm` (view models for MAUI, WPF, WinUI, UNO, Avalonia). Targets net10.0 and net11.0; all code is C# with `nullable enable`.

Each link below is a self-contained page: fetch only the one you need. These docs are also indexed on Context7 under `/psachmann/fetchling`; use `/psachmann/fetchling/v3.0.0` for the current stable release, since the unversioned ID tracks `main`.

## Start here

- [Introduction](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/introduction.html): what Fetchling is and the concepts behind it
- [Getting Started](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/getting-started.html): install, register with DI, write a first query and mutation

## Guides

- [Queries](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/guides/queries.html): the core read primitive: keys, options, state, lifecycle
- [Infinite Queries](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/guides/infinite-queries.html): paginated and "load more" data with page parameters
- [Streamed Queries](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/guides/streamed-queries.html): fold an `IAsyncEnumerable` of chunks into data as it arrives
- [Live Data (SSE & SignalR)](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/guides/live-data.html): write pushed data into the cache
- [Mutations](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/guides/mutations.html): writes, progress, cancellation, automatic invalidation
- [Prefetching](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/guides/prefetching.html): warm the cache before anything subscribes
- [Optimistic Updates](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/guides/optimistic-updates.html): predict a mutation result and roll back on failure
- [Caching](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/guides/caching.html): stale time, cache time, invalidation, eviction
- [Retry Handling](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/guides/retries.html): `IRetryHandler`; no retries by default
- [Observability](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/guides/observability.html): traces, metrics and logs using only BCL APIs
- [Server-Side Rendering](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/guides/ssr.html): `QueryExecutionMode` and DI lifetimes for CSR vs SSR

## UI integrations

- [Blazor Components](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/guides/blazor.html): `<Suspense>`, `<Transition>`, `<InfiniteSuspense>`, `<InfiniteTransition>`, `<QueryRefreshMonitor>`
- [MVVM View Models](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/guides/mvvm.html): bindable view models for XAML frameworks
- [DevTools](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/guides/devtools.html): the `<QueryDevTools>` live cache inspector
- [Cache Inspector](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/guides/cache-inspector.html): build your own inspector for any UI stack

## Reference

- [IQueryClient](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/api/Fetchling.Core.IQueryClient.html): the entry point: create queries and mutations, invalidate, set data
- [Fetchling.Core API](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/api/Fetchling.Core.html): generated reference for the core namespace
- [Fetchling.Blazor API](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/api/Fetchling.Blazor.html): generated reference for the Razor components
- [Fetchling.Mvvm API](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/api/Fetchling.Mvvm.html): generated reference for the view models

## Upgrading

- [Migrating from v2 to v3](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/migrating-to-v3.html): the rename from DotNetQuery, dropped net9.0, new `IQueryClient` members, `Invalidate` now ignoring `StaleTime` (use `InvalidateStale` for the old behaviour)
- [Migrating from v1 to v2](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/migrating-to-v2.html): reference-type `TData`, new members, automatic cache eviction, telemetry changes

## Optional

- [Contributing](https://psachmann.github.io/fetchling/doc/contributing.html): dev setup, build gates, release process
